analysis: Market Context: SPY is in confirmed DOWNTREND (-3.9% vs SMA50, 20d slope -0.15%), making capital preservation the primary mandate. Portfolio sits at 86% deployed across 6 positions with only $9,142 remaining headroom for new buys. The Sortino ratio of -8.45 is deeply negative, confirming that downside risk is outsized relative to returns — this is not a time to press. Position Review: AMP (-7.74%, $9,591) is the most urgent concern — it has failed to appear in the quality+trend screener, which screens out confirmed downtrends and quality deterioration. This is a thesis-break signal. With the broader market already in downtrend, holding a name in its own downtrend compounds drawdown risk needlessly. Recommend closing. NXPI (-4.18%) IS on the screener as UPTREND basing with PEG 0.50 and strong fundamentals — the modest drawdown is within normal range and thesis is intact. ADSK (+6.91%), UHS (+10.35%), and ULTA (+7.51%) are performing well, theses intact. FOXA (+1.54%) is uninspiring but not broken. New Buys: Candidates with the strongest quality signals (REGN, ACGL, LLY) are all >80% of their 52-week range — extended per our entry rules. SNPS and CPRT both have earnings within 10-29 days, adding event risk. INTU has earnings in 10 days. In a market downtrend with limited headroom and already 5 solid remaining positions after closing AMP, there is no asymmetric, properly-sized new setup that clears the bar. Cash is the correct incremental position. Closing AMP brings us to 5 positions (top of our 3-5 target) and $23k+ in cash — a disciplined, defensive posture appropriate to the regime.

trades.entry_strategy: Sell at market on next open to close the full 19-share long position. AMP has dropped from the quality+trend screener, signaling confirmed downtrend or quality deterioration. No need to leg out — full exit.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL THESIS BREAK: AMP (Ameriprise Financial) is absent from the quality+trend screener, which hard-filters any name in a confirmed downtrend or with deteriorating quality metrics. This absence is not random — it directly conflicts with our entry thesis. The position is already -7.74% from our $547.12 average cost. TECHNICAL: In a broad market DOWNTREND (SPY -3.9% vs SMA50), a name failing its own trend filter is doubly exposed. The Sortino ratio of -8.45 on this portfolio already signals that downside volatility is dominating — holding a thesis-broken name in this regime is the primary contributor to that dynamic. Exiting locks in a -7.74% loss but protects the remaining $9,591 from an estimated 15%+ further drawdown risk if AMP's downtrend persists. The opportunity cost of holding dead weight in a down market exceeds the pain of crystallizing this modest loss.
trades.exit_plan: Full exit at market, all 19 shares. The only condition under which re-entry would be considered: AMP re-enters the screener with UPTREND or confirmed basing signal AND the market regime shifts to sideways or uptrend. No re-entry on a bounce alone without screener confirmation. Freed capital held as cash — not redeployed until a genuinely asymmetric setup appears in a more favorable regime.
